sourcePolicy: Publish only current AVC vacancies whose public details have been verified from the concerned recruitment source. Do not invent employers, salaries, vacancy counts, deadlines, benefits, licences or selection claims.

lifecycle.expiryRule: Open and closing-soon jobs require validThrough. The website and vacancy-page generator remove a job from public discovery after validThrough.
lifecycle.freshnessRule: Every public job must carry lastVerifiedAt and must be rechecked within the publishing freshness window.
lifecycle.detailPageRule: Every public job requires a stable lowercase slug. Its detail page is generated at /vacancies/{slug}.html.
lifecycle.schemaRule: JobPosting structured data exists only on an individual vacancy detail page and only when the actual hiring organization is approved for public disclosure together with required location and date facts. AVC is never substituted as the employer.

jobPostingEligibility.note: A vacancy can have a public detail page without JobPosting schema when the actual hiring organization is not approved for public disclosure.
